ResourceHeader.ResourceName: ICON Extreme Ultraviolet and Far Ultraviolet Oplus data
ResourceHeader.Description:
This describes the Level 3.2 data product for ICON which is in NetCDF4 format. These files are named ICON_L3-2_YYYY-MM-DD_vXXrZZZ.NC, where YYYY-MM-DD is the year month day, XX shows the version number and ZZZ shows the revision number of this file. Each individual file contains one calendar day (24 hours) of data, merging data from the EUV and FUV Level 2 ionosphere products. The 12-second integration time is preserved in all samples. For FUV, the central 4 of 6 imaging stripes are used to match the EUV 12-deg horizontal field of regard. All data are filtered to remove flagged bad data (FUV Level 2.5 Data Quality = 0 in any of the 4 stripes, and EUV Level 2.6 Data Warning = 2). Consult the Level 2 data files for more information. Altitude profiles are generated on a 5-km resolution altitude grid. FUV data in all 4 stripes are binned and averaged using a weighted mean. EUV altitude profiles are interpolated onto the grid.
Each data source has been evaluated for precision to meet the original ICON science goals and requirements, but may require systematic offsets or scaling for accuracy in alternate applications, for details see: Nighttime (FUV) O+ validation : https://doi.org/10.1007/s11214-023-00970-2 Daytime (EUV) O+ validation : https://doi.org/10.1007/s11214-022-00930-2"

Parameter.Name: Epoch Time
Parameter.Description: Time corresponding to the center of each observation, in milliseconds since Jan 1 1970.

Parameter.Name: Geodetic Longitude
Parameter.Description: Geodetic longitude at retrieval location, in WGS referenced to 300 km tangent point for daytime (EUV), and to HmF2 tangent point location for nighttime (FUV).

Parameter.Name: O+ Density Altitude
Parameter.Description: Altitude corresponding to the retrieved quantities, in WGS84 in 5 km increments, centered, e.g. 150 km means 147.5 km <= Altitude < 152.5 km.

Parameter.Name: Magnetic Latitude
Parameter.Description: Quasi-dipole magnetic latitude at retrieval location, referenced to 300 km tangent point for daytime (EUV), and to HmF2 tangent point location for nighttime (FUV) calculated using the fast implementation developed by Emmert et al. (2010, doi:10.1029/2010JA015326) and the Python wrapper apexpy (https://github.com/aburrell/apexpy/).

Parameter.Name: Magnetic Longitude
Parameter.Description: Quasi-dipole magnetic longitude at retrieval location, referenced to 300 km tangent point for daytime (EUV), and to HmF2 tangent point location for nighttime (FUV) calculated using the fast implementation developed by Emmert et al. (2010, doi:10.1029/2010JA015326) and the Python wrapper apexpy (https://github.com/aburrell/apexpy/).

Parameter.Name: HMF2
Parameter.Description: Height of the peak electron density of the F2 layer from retrieval, in WGS.

Parameter.Name: HmF2 Error
Parameter.Description: 1-sigma uncertainty in height of the F2 layer peak from retrieval, as determined from the reported statistical uncertainties and/or weighted averaging of the measurements.

Parameter.Name: NMF2
Parameter.Description: Electron density at the peak of the F2 layer from retrieval.

Parameter.Name: NmF2 Error
Parameter.Description: 1-sigma uncertainty in electron density at the peak of the F2 layer as determined from the reported statistical uncertainties and/or weighted averaging of the measurements.

Parameter.Name: O+ Profile
Parameter.Description: Number density of O+ as a function of altitude.

Parameter.Name: O+ Profile Error
Parameter.Description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the number density of O+ as a function of altitude as determined from the reported statistical uncertainties and/or weighted averaging of the measurements.

Parameter.Name: Local Solar Time
Parameter.Description: Local Solar Time at retrieval location.

Parameter.Name: Solar Zenith Angle
Parameter.Description: Solar Zenith Angle at retrieval location.

Parameter.Name: Data Source
Parameter.Description: Data product contributing to each O+ measurement. Value: 2.5 is FUV nighttime ionosphere, 2.6 is EUV daytime ionosphere.
